events.name: Spawning Season
events.description: Spawning season is underway. Breeding events fire twice as often — eggs fill the reef. Managing nutrients becomes critical.
events.entry_copy: Spawning season is active. Eggs will appear constantly — hatch them fast and keep nutrients in check.

events.name: Bleaching Event
events.description: Ocean temperatures are rising. Stony corals take additional damage while temperature is at the warm threshold. Counter by spending coins on the temperature dial.
events.entry_copy: A bleaching event is active. Temperature will drift warm each turn unless you spend coins to hold it back. Stony corals are at risk.

events.name: Storm Surge
events.description: A storm is battering the reef. One random fish population loses a member at the start of each turn. Salinity is unstable — watch the dial.
events.entry_copy: Storm conditions are active. Fish populations are at risk each turn and salinity is fluctuating.

events.name: Cold Upwelling
events.description: Cold water is rising from depth. Deep-water species thrive but tropical fish are taking cold damage. Strategy shifts toward cold-tolerant species.
events.entry_copy: Cold upwelling is active. Tropical fish take cold damage this level. Favour cold-tolerant or deep-water species.

events.name: Algae Bloom
events.description: Algae is spreading across the reef. All corals take -1 per turn unless at least 3 herbivore fish are present. Parrotfish and Sergeant Major count.
events.entry_copy: Algae bloom is active. Keep at least 3 herbivore fish (Parrotfish or Sergeant Major) in your reef or corals will suffer.
